$comment: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers God-Agent can connect to. This is how God reaches external agents/tools across the internet. Copy to ~/.god-agent/mcp.json and edit. Enable the capability first: set mcp.enabled=true (goda settings mcp.enabled true). Each server exposes tools/agents that God calls through its audited pipeline. Unreachable servers are skipped gracefully.

servers.name: ui-tars
servers.description: UI-TARS-desktop (ByteDance) exposes a GUI-agent MCP server. Runs `agent-tars mcp` (install with: npm i -g @agent-tars/cli). Once enabled, God can hand a task to a desktop GUI agent that sees and clicks the screen.
